firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently visited Lisboa starts and takes the Starting Player marker.
clarifications: Play goes clockwise from that player.
Starting positions on the Influence Track depend on that order.
internalEvidence: The ©2017 Eagle-Gryphon Games English rulebook gives the most recent Lisboa visitor, Starting Player marker, clockwise play, and order-based Influence positions on page 5. Its title and Vital Lacerda credits match inventory BGG 161533. SHA-256: 922fd98bcb77b0dfd91eff6df88d5227dfc25abedfd2e58b8fb9817a2383b94e. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22.
uncertainty: No tie procedure is given for equally recent visitors.
